arguments.value: This agreement sets out natural gas transportation service between Arkansas Western Pipeline Company and Associated Natural Gas Company. The pipeline agrees to transport gas for the shipper under either firm or interruptible service, with a maximum daily quantity of 23,000 Dth, using receipt and delivery points listed in the exhibits. The shipper must deliver gas at the receipt points, and the transporter must redeliver an equivalent amount minus fuel use and shrinkage. The initial term is ten years starting when service begins, then it continues month to month until either side gives written notice to end it. Charges are based on the pipeline’s FTS/ITS tariff and can change if approved by regulators. For firm service, if pipeline capacity is reduced, the shipper’s entitlement is reduced proportionally with other firm shippers. The agreement also covers notice procedures, Arkansas law, and states it replaces prior transportation agreements. Later documents show a permanent partial release/assignment of 13,370 MMBtu/day of firm capacity from Associated Natural Gas to United Cities Gas Company (Atmos Energy) at the same interconnected receipt and delivery points.
